newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-DEMAND FOR LATS KEEPS O/N, LAT RATES UP.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-DEMAND FOR LATS KEEPS O/N, LAT RATES UP.

text.p: Demand for lats ahead of the state's auction of one million Unibanka shares and other privatisation opportunities kept overnight and lat rates high, dealers said on Friday.
Overnight rates have been relatively stable most of the week and were at a bid/ask of 3.80/4.80 on Friday with few signs of falling much in the short-term, dealers said.
The interbank lat/dollar rate was 0.5786/0.5801, below the Bank of Latvia's intervention rate of 0.5797.
"Banks are selling dollars every chance they get...there is a lot of demand for lats right now," said one dealer.
"We've seen a number of orders from foreigners," he added.
Dealers said Monday's auction of the Unibanka shares for a minimum 3.05 lats per share was one factor driving both the foreign and domestic the demand for lats.
The lat's popularity is expected to remain high as Russia's Gazprom is seen coming to the market soon to pay for its stake in Latvian Gas.
But dealers added that turnover was not particularly high on the foreign exchange markets.
"We've been doing about two to four million dollars worth of deals per day," said one dealer with Hansabank-Latvija.
